title: Three-winding transformer (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. A three-winding transformer described over the authored star equivalent: a star bus and three two-winding legs. The pairwise nameplate impedances are referred to the common base baseMva; the editor's derive-star-legs helper (a later slice) uses Z1 = (Z12 + Z13 - Z23)/2 and its cyclic forms. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: the authored leg r and x stay what the solver uses.

baseMva.description: The common MVA base the pairwise impedances are on.

x23Pu.description: MV-LV reactance on baseMva, per unit.
